description: This file defines a singleton-like enum GatewayLaunchAgentManager responsible for managing launch agents related to a gateway service on macOS. It includes functions for enabling/disabling the launch agent, checking its status, reading configurations, and executing related shell commands. It also provides utilities for snapshotting launchd configurations and determining log paths.

methods.name: isLaunchAgentWriteDisabled
methods.description: Checks if the launch agent write is disabled by verifying the existence of a specific marker file.

methods.name: setLaunchAgentWriteDisabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the launch agent write by creating or removing a marker file.

methods.name: isLoaded
methods.description: Asynchronously checks if the daemon is loaded by reading its status.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Enables or disables the launch agent, running the appropriate install or uninstall commands.

methods.name: launchdConfigSnapshot
methods.description: Returns a snapshot of the current launchd configuration as a custom object.

methods.name: launchdGatewayLogPath
methods.description: Determines the appropriate log path from the launchd configuration or defaults.
